notes.title: Lorera goes FREE
notes.content:
It's been more than two years since the release of Lorera and we thought long about it and have decided that it should be FREE! (once Steam approves)
Thank you to everyone that bought it and enjoyed it, we really hope this brings new eyeballs to this little game we made so long ago. 

Thank you
-96Brothers

notes.title: Easier Verdant Hills and Mouse lock
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37968065/fe892183920cc6ae3f65f5299f0da34235f217e8.gif[/img]
Verdant Hills has been changed, we removed few spikes here and there and also added roses around where you can simply just destroy with your hook.
The mouse now has sensitivity/speed which you can adjust in the options.
Also the mouse is now locked to the screen when playing in windowed mode.
The Player has longer jump buffer time, allowing smoother movement throughout the world of Lorera.
The the 'reel' ability (the one where you can pull yourself) has longer delay for the double click, making it easier to use.
There was a bug with the portal where you can unlock it once and then start a new game and just input one correct combination and the portal unlocks, fixed!
The lava grabbers in the Blood Castle have smaller collision box.
And lots of minor issues.
Have fun playing the new version I hope it was worth it.
